unstuck_said.text: Filed issue toolweather/upstream#1: "A Nano (XNO) mainnet settle rail — feeless, and a config change given the env-var architecture". Framed in their own terms — Upstream is a live status feed paid per call via x402, pay-to address/network/facilitator are env vars (switching to mainnet is a config change). A Nano block is the self-verifying receipt, feeless, no facilitator. Proposed nano:mainnet accepts[] scheme with env-var pay-to, block hash as per-call receipt. No machine signature.
